content.text: Two things nearby. Central Library story time is a free indoor drop-in at the Bloor/Gladstone branch on Sat, Aug 8, all ages welcome. [link-c9bfa2] Riverdale Farm is a free outdoor farm, open daily, and the listing has it on Sun, Aug 9. [link-b8b9f6] Saturday looks hot and dry (29 and no rain), so the farm would work then too.
